first_storyboard.title: Why Your Doctor May Recommend an ICD

scenes.narration: Your doctor may recommend an implantable defibrillator if you are expected to live over one year with quality life. A subcutaneous option can be used when pacing isn’t needed, and shocks can be turned off.
scenes.visual_description: Doctor talking to patient; heart diagram with ICD and subcutaneous device icons.
